title: CPF Module Schema: Firewall module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-firewall'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dns_servers.description: (Required) A list of DNS servers that the Azure Firewall will direct DNS traffic to the for name resolution.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

firewall_policy_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Firewall Policy applied to this Firewall.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ip_configurations.type: map(object({ isPrimary = bool subnet_id = string public_ip_address_id = string }))

managed_by.description: (Required) Whether the firewall is managed by Policy or Rules (Classic). Valid values are 'Policy' and 'Rules'

management_ip_configuration.type: object({ name = string subnet_id = string public_ip_address_id = string })
management_ip_configuration.description: (Optional) A management_ip_configuration allows force-tunnelling of traffic to be performed by the firewall. Adding or removing this block or changing the subnet_id in an existing block forces a new resource to be created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

private_ip_ranges.description: (Optional) A list of SNAT private CIDR IP ranges, or the special string IANAPrivateRanges, which indicates Azure Firewall does not SNAT when the destination IP address is a private range per IANA RFC 1918.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku_name.description: (Required) SKU name of the Firewall. Possible values are `AZFW_Hub` and `AZFW_VNet`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

sku_tier.description: (Required) SKU tier of the Firewall. Possible values are Premium, Standard and Basic.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

threat_intel_mode.description: (Optional) The operation mode for threat intelligence-based filtering. Possible values are: Off, Alert and Deny. Defaults to Alert.

virtual_hub.description: (Optional) An Azure Virtual WAN Hub with associated security and routing policies configured by Azure Firewall Manager. Use secured virtual hubs to easily create hub-and-spoke and transitive architectures with native security services for traffic governance and protection.

zones.description: (Required) Need to provide all three availability zones(1,2,3) to ensure Azure Firewall is highly redundant. Changing this forces a new Azure Firewall to be created.

id.description: The ID of the created Firewall.

name.description: The name of the created Firewall.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Firewall' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
